name: frenzy
desc: Starting when you choose this path at 3rd level, you can go into a frenzy when you @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.classfeatures.Item.VoR0SUrNX5EJVPIO]{Rage}. If you do so, for the duration of your rage you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns after this one. When your rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion (as described in appendix A).
